master.description: Run in master mode (create virtual interface). If false, run in slave mode.

listen_port.description: TCP port to listen on when acting as a slave (used with -s). Set to 0 to disable listening.

connect_to.description: Remote host:port to connect to as a master (used with -c).

interface.description: Name of the physical Ethernet interface to capture traffic from (used with -i).

virtual_iface.description: Name of the virtual TUN/TAP interface to create in master mode (used with -I).

use_bpf.description: If false, disable BPF filtering (equivalent to -B).

use_ssh_filter.description: Use SSH_CONNECTION environment variable to build BPF filter (equivalent to -S).

bpf_filter.description: Manual BPF filter specification, e.g., 'src:10.0.0.1:22,dst:192.168.1.1:22' (used with -M).

copy_params.description: If false, do not copy real interface parameters to virtual interface (equivalent to -C).
